Onmyo Knight Towako
 
Towako Yagyuu is the protagonist of Onmyo Knight Towako.

A rogue but noble Onmyoji Knight, who is able to fight demons and criminal Onmyouji with her powerful Dog Spirirt Vánagandr.

Z-Zip it! I can go on a rampage without my butler's permission!! Tsk! Dang!
Yagyuu Towako

Personality
Towako while working as an Onmyouji, is rude, aggressive and talks in a very informal way fitting the trope of a "Yankee Girl".

Her colleagues and those, on the dark contacts, fear her outbursts at times and are well informed about her. Easy to anger, sometimes jumping to violence and brutal acts she is not considered lady-like to most that know her in her job. However, because of the influence of her butler, Shiki Reika, she tries to act really polite and lady-like but tends to slip up, sometimes reverting to her rude ways if annoyed. She is loved by her neighbors, that wish to protect her as they only know her soft and mature side. Towako is able to play around but often hides her more lazy and rude attributes not to anger Reika.

On the positive side, she will go out of her way to rescue her friends, regardless of them no longer working together and is willing to even work without pay, as long as it brings evil people to justice. She still loves her mother and father dearly and will not hold back if anybody insults them. Towako is actually very intelligent and does not only have overwhelming strength, but because of her direct approach and arrogance, runs into trouble when she tries to do things alone, without support. Towako is overly stubborn and lacks at times communication skills, which can doom her missions. She shares this flaw especially in regards to her grandfather.

Appearance
She has long blond hair and cyan eyes.

While on the job she wears a black miniskirt, black west, white shirt and thigh-high socks

History
Background
Towako, born Abe Towako, is a member of the Abe clan.

A human prodigy, which became an Onmyoji at the age of 13. Though not much is known about her parents, her father was probably the son of Abe Yumei and it is stated she got her looks from her mother. At the age of 14, she was the youngest Onmyoji Knight ever, with the Inugami (Dog God) Vanalgand as her Shikigami Spirit. Trained by her senior Yuko Sakura, in the Onmyo Agency, to be the very best.

Her Onmyoji parents owned a private library called "Shinmachi Paperback, Private Library", which has a huge collection of old books and scrolls from across the world. Her father had helped members of the Sonezaki Shokai and the boss Isamu Kondo, still owns Towako an eternal favor, supporting her with intel and information. She had visited in her youth at least a number of high society parties with her parents, and was known by her parents colleges and school friends. Her grandfather was Abe Yumei the most powerful Onmyoji, also known as a sword sait, and was one of the leaders in the Onmyo Agency. Making her a potential heir of the abe family.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Summon Paper and P100 submachine gun

Familiar: Vanargand (Vánagandr), is her to summon the Inugami (Dog God).
Equal Power: One of Vanargand's abilities it that it gives the user extreme physical power equal to himself, unlike other Onmyoji, Towako can physically fight spirits, with physical power.
Emotional Fueled: The abilities of her and Vanargand are proportional to her will power or rage she feels.
Beast Mode: An alternative form of her Familiar powering it up a lot, able to hit enemies with a certain kill move and control spiritual power to a degree.
Basic element magic: She can create light and strong long distance attacks.
